findings.title: AWS IAM role accepts a principal in any AWS account
findings.detail: AWS role 'any-principal' accepts IAM principals from any AWS account: arn:aws:iam::*:role/*.

findings.title: AWS EC2 role is not bound to an account or instance
findings.detail: AWS EC2 role 'ec2-region-only' is not bound to an account, VPC, subnet, IAM role or instance: an instance in any AWS account that matches the remaining bounds can log in.

findings.title: GCP IAM role accepts any service account in any project
findings.detail: GCP IAM role 'any-sa' accepts every service account (bound_service_accounts=*) with no bound_projects: a service account in any GCP project can log in.

findings.title: GCP GCE role is not bound to a project or service account
findings.detail: GCP GCE role 'gce-zone-only' is not bound to a project or service account: an instance in any GCP project that matches the remaining bounds can log in.

findings.title: Role can issue tokens with the root policy
findings.detail: Token role 'ops-root' allows creating tokens with the root policy.

findings.title: Kubernetes role accepts any service account in any namespace
findings.detail: Kubernetes role 'any-pod' accepts every service account in every namespace of the cluster.

findings.title: Kubernetes role accepts any service account in any namespace
findings.detail: Kubernetes role 'any-pod' accepts every service account in every namespace of the cluster.

findings.title: Kubernetes role accepts any service account in any namespace
findings.detail: Kubernetes role 'batch-any-pod' accepts every service account in every namespace of the cluster.

findings.title: Azure role accepts any identity in the tenant
findings.detail: Azure role 'any-sp' binds bound_service_principal_ids=* with no subscription, resource group or scale set bound: any identity in the configured tenant can log in.

findings.title: Azure role accepts any identity in the tenant
findings.detail: Azure role 'any-sp-eastus' binds bound_service_principal_ids=* with no subscription, resource group or scale set bound: any identity in the configured tenant with a VM in eastus can log in.

findings.title: Cert auth role accepts any certificate its CA signed
findings.detail: Cert role 'any-cert' sets no name, organization or extension constraint: any client certificate its trusted CA signed can log in.

findings.title: Cert auth role matches names with a catch-all wildcard
findings.detail: Cert role 'wild' matches names with a catch-all wildcard (allowed_common_names=*): any certificate its trusted CA signed passes that check.

findings.title: GCP IAM role accepts every service account in its projects
findings.detail: GCP IAM role 'project-wide' accepts every service account in project acme-prod.

findings.title: PKI issuer certificate expires within the critical window
findings.detail: Issuer 'critical' expires in 9 days (2026-10-29T06:11:12Z).

findings.title: PKI mount has both CRL and OCSP disabled
findings.detail: PKI mount 'pki_off/' publishes no CRL and answers no OCSP, so revoked certificates can't be detected.

findings.title: JWT role is bound only by audience
findings.detail: JWT role 'ci-audience-only' checks only the audience: any token the issuer mints for that audience can log in.

findings.title: JWT/OIDC role binds claims with a wildcard
findings.detail: Role 'ci-wildcard' matches bound claims with wildcards: repository.

findings.title: Kubernetes role accepts any service account name or any namespace
findings.detail: Kubernetes role 'any-ns' accepts any namespace.

findings.title: AppRole role does not require a secret ID
findings.detail: AppRole 'role-id-only' logs in with the role ID alone; the role ID becomes a static password.

findings.title: A rekey of the unseal or recovery keys is in progress
findings.detail: A unseal key rekey is in progress (0 of 1 key shares provided).

findings.title: AWS IAM role matches principals by name, not unique ID
findings.detail: AWS role 'scoped' matches IAM principals by ARN only: a principal deleted and recreated with the same name still logs in.

findings.title: AWS EC2 role allows instance migration
findings.detail: AWS EC2 role 'ec2-migrating' allows instance migration, which weakens the protection against a reused identity document.

findings.title: Azure role binds no specific service principal or group
findings.detail: Azure role 'loc-only' binds no specific service principal or group: Vault 1.20+ refuses every login through it, older versions admit any identity in the tenant that matches its other bounds.

findings.title: Azure role binds a resource group or scale set in any subscription
findings.detail: Azure role 'rg-any-group' binds bound_resource_groups without bound_subscription_ids: a same-named resource in any subscription of the tenant matches.

findings.title: GCP IAM role accepts signed JWTs valid longer than 15 minutes
findings.detail: GCP IAM role 'long-jwt' accepts signed JWTs valid for up to 3600s (default 900s), so a stolen JWT stays replayable longer.

findings.title: PKI issuer certificate expires within the warning window
findings.detail: Issuer 'nested' expires in 31 days (2026-11-20T06:11:12Z).

findings.title: PKI issuer certificate expires within the warning window
findings.detail: Issuer 'warning' expires in 31 days (2026-11-20T06:11:34Z).

findings.title: PKI mount has automatic tidy disabled
findings.detail: PKI mount 'ca/int/' has automatic tidy disabled; expired certificates and revocation entries accumulate in storage.

findings.title: PKI mount has automatic tidy disabled
findings.detail: PKI mount 'pki/' has automatic tidy disabled; expired certificates and revocation entries accumulate in storage.

findings.title: PKI mount has automatic tidy disabled
findings.detail: PKI mount 'pki_off/' has automatic tidy disabled; expired certificates and revocation entries accumulate in storage.

findings.title: PKI issuer has no AIA issuing-certificates URL
findings.detail: Neither issuer 'nested' nor its mount publishes an issuing-certificates (AIA) URL, so clients can't fetch the chain.

findings.title: PKI issuer has no AIA issuing-certificates URL
findings.detail: Neither issuer 'critical' nor its mount publishes an issuing-certificates (AIA) URL, so clients can't fetch the chain.

findings.title: PKI issuer has no AIA issuing-certificates URL
findings.detail: Neither issuer 'warning' nor its mount publishes an issuing-certificates (AIA) URL, so clients can't fetch the chain.

findings.title: PKI issuer lets leaf certificates outlive it
findings.detail: Issuer 'critical' signs leaves whose validity runs past its own expiry (leaf_not_after_behavior=permit).

findings.title: External plugin is registered without a version
findings.detail: External secret plugin 'posture-dummy' is registered without a version, so upgrades and pinning can't be tracked.

findings.title: Quotas exist but none applies to the whole cluster
findings.detail: 1 rate-limit quota(s) exist, but all are scoped to a path, namespace or role; nothing caps the rest of the cluster.

findings.title: OIDC role logs tokens and claims verbosely
findings.detail: Role 'sso' writes ID tokens and claims to the server log (verbose_oidc_logging).

findings.title: AppRole secret IDs never expire
findings.detail: AppRole 'forever-secret' issues secret IDs that never expire.

findings.title: Role issues periodic tokens with no explicit max TTL
findings.detail: Role 'forever-secret' issues periodic tokens (period 86400s) with no explicit max TTL, so they can be renewed forever.

findings.title: External (non-builtin) plugins are registered
findings.detail: 1 external plugin(s) are registered; each runs third-party code inside Vault's trust boundary.

findings.title: Requests rejected by rate-limit quotas are not audit-logged
findings.detail: Rate-limit quotas are defined, but requests they reject are not written to the audit log.

findings.title: Time-based automatic barrier key rotation is disabled
findings.detail: Automatic barrier key rotation has no time interval; the key only rotates on the operation-count limit or by hand.
